source_references: Project-owned 0.2.51 hand/body matte originals and 0.2.48 NPC original, preserved externally. No third-party sprite.

prompts.hand: Use case: identity-preserve. Project sprite animation production, not a concept board. Input is an existing sprite sheet reference; preserve its exact character/material identity and palette. Create an expanded sheet of genuinely redrawn animation cels, not rotations, duplicates or scaling. No labels, no grid lines, no text, no watermark. Each sprite entirely isolated with generous empty margins. Genuinely transparent background if supported; otherwise perfectly flat solid #00FF00 green, including gaps, no checkerboard and no shadows on the background. Exactly 16 cels arranged 4 columns by 4 rows in reading order. Same long three-taloned Gothic ivory and charcoal armored hand, wrist socket at top, claws down. Fixed wrist size and anchor, same camera angle. Cels 0-7 progressively open/spread the long fingers with changing knuckle plates and tendon strain. Cels 8-15 progressively snap shut into a gripping claw, including distinct intermediate hooked finger poses; retain long sinister silhouette. No human skin or doll-girl hands. All sixteen sockets at same relative cell position; all claws fit each cell. Preserve reference's pixel-art clustering. Use large sheet with detailed silhouettes.
prompts.body: Use case: identity-preserve. Project sprite animation production, not a concept board. Input is an existing sprite sheet reference; preserve its exact character/material identity and palette. Create an expanded sheet of genuinely redrawn animation cels, not rotations, duplicates or scaling. No labels, no grid lines, no text, no watermark. Each sprite entirely isolated with generous empty margins. Genuinely transparent background if supported; otherwise perfectly flat solid #00FF00 green, including gaps, no checkerboard and no shadows on the background. Exactly 16 cels arranged 4 columns by 4 rows in reading order. Same tall abstract Gothic ivory restraint torso, charcoal hollow almond slit, thorn-like upper spire, rib-like curved ivory plates, lower clasp. No human face, no girl head. A coherent breathing/straining animation: frames 0-7 gradually flex plates outward as slit widens, 8-15 gradually fold plates back to original pose. Distinct subtly redrawn plate edges and inner shadow in each cel, not rigid transforms. Anchor top spire and maintain fixed overall width scale and camera. Preserve pixel-art clustering. All 16 pieces connected single silhouettes, no detached debris.
prompts.npc: Use case: identity-preserve. Project sprite animation production, not a concept board. Input is an existing sprite sheet reference; preserve its exact character/material identity and palette. Create an expanded sheet of genuinely redrawn animation cels, not rotations, duplicates or scaling. No labels, no grid lines, no text, no watermark. Each sprite entirely isolated with generous empty margins. Genuinely transparent background if supported; otherwise perfectly flat solid #00FF00 green, including gaps, no checkerboard and no shadows on the background. Exactly 12 full-body pixel-art NPC cels arranged 4 columns by 3 rows. Same small white-haired pale ball-jointed girl with black Gothic bonnet, restrained black frilled dress, quiet sad eyes, boots, no new accessories. Designed to reduce to a legible Terraria 32x52 sprite. Consistent body size and feet baseline, static camera, no walking translation. In reading order cels: 0 neutral quiet standing eyes open; 1 half blink; 2 eyes closed blink; 3 head slightly looks toward left; 4 head turned a little further with gaze down; 5 returns head partway; 6 one hand starts rising; 7 hand gently rests on chest; 8 both hands clasp briefly; 9 slight forward bow starting; 10 deeper but restrained sad bow; 11 returning halfway upright. Small distinct hair/frill follow-through in poses, keep full silhouette and feet in same spot. Not cute cartoon reaction faces. No carried toy. Every cel separated from others.

export.details: Green matte key; 16 connected hand/body islands, fixed socket/spire registration and common per-axis scale fitting all poses without per-frame stretching. Native NPC 12 cells, bottom-foot registration, common horizontal/vertical fit to 32x52, nearest sampling and retained 32-colour palette. Original art and mechanical 4x NPC preview remain externally archived; runtime alpha/edges checked.
